name: CASP Qualitative Research Checklist
license_note: Questions are consolidated paraphrases of the official checklist. The official wording is linked, not bundled.
notes: CASP questions are answered yes / can't tell / no and CASP defines no scoring or overall judgement, so none is derived. Qualitative appraisal is about the adequacy of the reported reasoning, not a bias direction.

domains.name: Clear statement of aims
domains.short_prompt: Whether the aims of the research and why the qualitative approach was chosen are stated clearly.

domains.name: Appropriate qualitative approach
domains.short_prompt: Whether a qualitative approach is appropriate for the research issue and the design fits the aims.

domains.name: Appropriate recruitment
domains.short_prompt: Whether the recruitment strategy is appropriate to the aims and its limitations are discussed.

domains.name: Data collection addresses the issue
domains.short_prompt: Whether the data collection methods (interview, focus group, observation) address the research issue and the justification is adequate.

domains.name: Researcher reflexivity
domains.short_prompt: Whether the relationship between researcher and participants is considered, including the researcher's potential influence.

domains.name: Ethical considerations
domains.short_prompt: Whether ethical issues — consent, harm, confidentiality, power imbalance — have been considered.

domains.name: Sufficiently rigorous analysis
domains.short_prompt: Whether the data analysis was sufficiently rigorous — adequate description, systematic discussion of findings, counter-examples considered.

domains.name: Value of the findings
domains.short_prompt: Whether the findings are valuable — clear primary findings, discussion of their significance, and contribution to existing knowledge.

domains.name: Culture, practice, and scope
domains.short_prompt: Whether there is a statement of local culture and practice, and whether the lack of generalisability is discussed.
